name: The Emotionally Ill
overview: Scripture provides comfort and strength to those who are emotionally distressed, assuring believers that God is present to uphold and help them in their fears and anxieties. Trust in God's sovereign care encourages us not to fear earthly troubles but to place our hope in Him, who offers eternal life through Christ. By renewing our minds and presenting our requests to God in prayer, we align ourselves with His perfect will, confident that all things work together for good for those who love Him.
